notes.title: News and Small Update
notes.notes:
[h2]We have some news.[/h2]

We have expanded our team and are working on training our new team members. We have also begun the development of a new game. We still plan on working on Pact of Steel alongside this new game, and we are scheduled to release Pact of Steel fully out of early access before the end of the year.

[h2]In this update, we bring some minor changes:[/h2]

[olist]

[*] Buffed Troop Factory Allies & Axis Unit Spawn Times to:

lvl 0: 90 → 55

lvl 1: 55 → 47.5 = 5 → 7.5

lvl 2: 47.5 → 37.5 = 7.5 → 10

lvl 3: 37.5 → 22.5 = 10 → 15

This will allow units to spawn significantly faster and will allow for the spawned unit cap to be actually hit. Prior to this, it was impossible to hit the unit limit even on the largest of maps.

[*] Fixed Typo on the PIAT unit description.
[*] Fixed Tankette scale it is now properly sized in the main menu and on American Desert Maps, and endless mode
[*] Cleaned up links on the store page as Steam deprecated them. The Discord link is now directly in the "Social Media Links" section
[/olist]

We thank you for playing Pact of Steel and hope you enjoy the 2 years of progress on our project. Pact of Steel hits 2 years old at the end of this month.

notes.title: Wave Control Overhaul Update
notes.notes:
In this update, we have finally overhauled the old wave skip system. Now it changes how the game plays to suit you better, our player. There are 3 different styles of waves now, eliminating all hostiles, letting the player manually start the next wave, and a timed approach. So lets get further into detail.

[h2]Wave Control System[/h2] 

[list]
[*] Eliminate Hostiles
[*] Player Starts
[*] Timed Start (Default)
[/list]

[h3]Eliminate Hostiles[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43541946/ef1d4e11cabe006e3334d069b74a6e0bb45d6b4d.png[/img]

So in this approach, the next wave will not start until all enemies are defeated, or have entered the HQ.
Once this condition is met the next wave will start

[h3]Player Starts[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43541946/915e5d45f1e4db1ad778e335dd7e9bf7e59f0002.png[/img]

In this approach, the next wave will start whenever the player chooses to. The moment the previous wave has finished spawning the option to start the next wave is activated. You can choose whenever to start the next wave giving you full control of the waves.

This approach is great for allowing you to reorganize towers in between waves, set up squads, and buy bunkers. The wave timer will keep ticking though so the longer you wait the longer the timer gets.

The start wave button will pulse and a reminder will pop up every 15 seconds to just remind you, that you need to start the next wave. Just as you would when starting the waves for the first time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43541946/b77003e8c761f4162d9b82df4199fd404e60c34a.png[/img]

[h3]Timed Start[/h3]

The final approach, timed start is what was previously in the game before this update, and will be the default. In this approach, there are 2 different conditions either X(60 seconds by default) seconds are met, or all hostiles are defeated. Whichever comes first.

You have an option to select from 5 to 120 seconds. Where 5 seconds is essentially starting the next wave as soon as possible. Pick a number that works for you, but do beware putting such a low number can have performance impacts depending on your system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43541946/e8f08ab1e5698d172249021bd5106e53e87e1647.png[/img]

We recommend everyone try out the options pick the one that works for them and play the game how you want to play. You're able to swap these in the options mid-game as well, although you might have to wait one wave depending on when you changed the setting.

notes.title: Bunker Update and New Map
notes.notes:
Happy Steam Summer Sale everyone!

[h2]Bunker Information[/h2]

With this update, we bring a long-awaited feature, bunkers. To sum it up a bunker is essentially a building where units can be placed safely. Where safety will be useful once planes become a threat.

The way we implemented this is by having specific bunkers around the map have an event on them to purchase, when purchasing the bunker you will always get a unit inside of it, and if the bunker has more slots you can fill those slots with preset options.

As we specifically design bunkers to fit into each map we decided to only use preset options with custom stats per map. This also means you don't have to worry about properly placing the unit as we already did it for you. Bunkers will not count toward the unit limit so they can be considered an additional unit you don't have to bring, as well as they get some of the most powerful units in the game.

Also mounted units in bunkers have the fastest bullet velocity in the game, meaning their bullet will collide with an enemy faster than any other unit in the game, assuming the same distance away. 7000 bullet velocity for the mounted mg and 3000 for most units in the game for reference.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43541946/d5c1bd3fbdccdb4280de6d8a64be049966d08fb5.jpg[/img]

Here is a picture of an unpurchased bunker, outlined in green is the range of the new unit inside the bunker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43541946/23df0aa3695de954dc59a413b14f58e07cd43751.jpg[/img]

Here is a purchased bunker with 2/4 slots full, while previewing a slot and seeing the unit's stats in that slot. Multiple options can appear for a slot, i.e. a rifleman or a machine gunner one of which can be picked.

These units are not upgradeable and do not have options for target selection. However, you can sell the unit in the slot if you so wish. We wanted to keep this as simple as possible so we chose not to add those features, if it's something desired you can let us know and we can work in into the bunker UI and provide upgrades for the units. Currently, a Mounted Bunker MG is approximately equal to a level 2 MG Unit in the game, with up to 3 times its range. We have a few variations of Mounted Bunker MGs depending on the angle of the viewport and balancing. 

[h2]Bridge 4 Map[/h2]

Here is the 4th map in the bridge campaign, we're one map away from finalizing this campaign. This map consists of 45 maps, with bridge 5 going to consist of 50.

This map follows the style of the previous campaign except only one lane follows a bridge, the other lane will walk across terrain taking a longer path. A bunker overlooks much of the terrain so it would be beneficial to destroy the bridge and utilize the bunker to decimate light infantry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43541946/b46f5806ab59244a0a74f490c361d4b99b8f3b9c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43541946/c88781a9c836f41fd61de85bd1e4ad410b9119bf.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43541946/ea4aafb32bafd1a2eb4e17c809f6056b4cf3ca67.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43541946/3f9e546f1fe590912c81b892da2c041e04e70d19.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bunker System with currently only in the Bridge campaign more will be added soon to older maps
[*] Bridge 4
[*] Removed wave skip, it was very buggy and has been scrapped. The achievement will be removed in a patch in the following week and be replaced with a new bunker achievement.
[*] Increased bullet velocity on most units from 1500 to 3000 as we raised the range of all the units but never the velocity. Projectile units will remain the same, grenadier and mortar.

Enjoy the new map we added and expect to see a major update next month to do with bunkers.

[h2]New Bridge Map[/h2]

This is the 3rd map in the Bridge Campaign as always following the destroyable bridge format the single bridge is destroyable rerouting both lanes of enemies into one longer lane. This map takes place in a small abandoned rural town centering around a fortified church being a good point to place infantry on top of.

We're hoping to push out the remaining 2 Bridge maps for the next update but we'll see how development goes for the bunker update and how constricted on time we are with that.

notes.title: New Map and Tutorial Remake Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New Bridge Map[/h1]
We are starting this update by adding a new map to our Bridge Campaign. This level follows the same concept as the previous one.

You can now blow up one of the bridges on every map in the campaign. This means that enemies can no longer walk on that path forcing it into a single lane map. Any enemies standing on the bridge when it was destroyed will be killed and points will be rewarded to the user. It will instakill any amount of health/armor, and full money is awarded.

Reworked the entire bridge campaign wave structure and increased starting money to 1300. This consists of many new unique enemies such as the Panther, Pershing, Jeep, Kubelwagen, and many more. There is a new unique spawning truck, which enemies will periodically spawn out the rear of a truck and will continue doing so until it's destroyed.

Some minor changes to the original map, where more foilage was added to make it look fuller.

All maps also have changed illumination so all shadows will be deeper and overall maps will look nicer.

notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary Update and Sale
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Pact of Steel 1 Year Anniversary[/b][/h1]
Pact of Steel will be going on a 10% sale for our 1 year anniversary. This will run from February 27th - March 1st (3 Days).

[h1][b]New Bridge Campaign[/b][/h1]
We're excited to share the first map of our upcoming campaign, focusing on rivers and bridges. This particular map offers a two bridges for added complexity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43541946/849b9931689320edf5c0f2d79788aed50f15e55e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43541946/33dd818948a7a3b56a63b80ab247c085000eb1fd.jpg[/img]
We're committed to delivering progressively challenging experiences moving forward, so this campaign will be starting at 30 waves and each map will only go up. However, we'll carefully balance the unit numbers per wave to avoid excessively lengthy gameplay. So more waves, but less enemies in each wave, yet we'll make them stronger to make up for the amount of enemies.

Keep an eye out over the next month as we release more maps in the bridge campaign. We're still fine-tuning some exciting new features to enhance your gameplay. We wanted to give you an early peek, before releasing the remainder of the maps so try it out now.

notes.title: Support Units Update
notes.notes:
[h2][b]New Support Units[/b][/h2]
Hey everyone, here is the new Anti-Tank (AT) Mine Laying Unit. This will be the first of our support units, which we are classifying as units that do not directly attack enemies. This unit will lay mines on the path within its range. It will be a very powerful unit which its mines will only be set off by enemy vehicles. Its powerful damage will be balanced by having a finite amount of mines placed per unit with a decent cooldown between each mine placement.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43541946/52c04e89fbfd9ff9f9814613e5731997adc2ff3c.jpg[/img]
We will also be regularly adding support units so keep an eye out here or on the steam patch notes for more information.

Some more notes:
[list]
[*] Nearby mines will not chain each other, so the explosion of one won’t destroy multiple potentially wasting them nor will any other explosive set them off
[*] Mines will splash damage and hurt any enemy in the blast radius including infantry but will not be set off by infantry
[*] We will add an Anti-Personal Mine Unit as well, which will also be very useful in our upcoming new game mode
[*] Lightly armored vehicles will set off the explosion, potentially overkilling and wasting damage so keep this in mind with your placement
[*] A set number of mines can exist on the map at once, and the unit has a placement cooldown, once that limit is reached it will idle until a mine has been set off
[*] Cannot be in a squad, this goes for all support units at the time of writing this
[/list]

[h2][b]Winter Maps[/b][/h2]
We have added two additional Winter maps. Winter 4 is a large uphill battle with two long paths and Winter 5 is a shorter and difficult wishbone shaped path set in a dense forest with less snow.

Reworked Forest maps 1-5. We realized these maps were old and overall, mostly just long paths without any actual tower defense aspects in them, so we fixed them and revamped them to our new standard we are push with all the new maps.

[h1][b]Crash Recovery[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Once a unexpected closing of the game happens, such as a crash, power outage, or even pressing ALT-F4 on your computer an autosave is created
[*] Then you are prompted to recover your game if you’d like to proceed on with your last level, if so, it will load your old save up. Otherwise, that save will be permanently deleted.
[*] The game only takes autosaves at the start of each wave, so anything in between two waves will be lost, although most of the waves are fast so a maximum of 3 minutes of progress would be lost (in 1x speed).
[/list]
[h2]Guide[/h2]
The guide has been updated to help players with information from the Squad update. It also now shows the icons and color coding we use for various things in the game.

[h2]Performance Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed shadows on certain foliage in Desert 5, to lower GPU usage.
[*] Fully optimized the enemy units, now the further away the enemies are the game will account for that and start to unrender guns and start to delay the tick time on animations. Essentially the enemy will do much less visually to save on performance when out of the camera’s view, but still maintain full effects when up close, therefore not compromising any visuals but getting significantly better performance.
[*] Temporarily disabled vehicles matching the angle of terrain. This was setup in a poor manner and is significantly destroying performance once more than on vehicle exists on the map, to fix this immediately we disabled this feature and will readd it in the following updates properly.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]

[*] Fixed Tower pathfinding, no longer will your units take the longest path possible around the map, they will now attempt to find the best possible path, while preventing them from crossing a path if possible but without compromising the distance walked.

[/list]

notes.title: Squad Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Squads[/b][/h1]
You can now hold shift to select multiple towers, selecting 3 units allows you to form a squad from them. We have also added an Auto Squad button when clicking units for the lazy people.

Primary units take both of their secondary units buffs plus they receive their own buff. While secondary units only apply their own buff to themselves. For example a squad of 1 machine gunner and 2 assault will have these buffs: Machinegunner buff {+10% range, +5% Damage, +5% Damage}, Assault {+5% Damage}, Assault {+5% Damage}.

So you may select 1 Primary Unit to base the squad on, and 2 secondary units to form the squad and provide bonuses to. You can also choose to make a squad of entirely secondary units.
You also will have to disband the squad to sell the units within it.

notes.title: Unit Movement Update
notes.notes:
We've realized the game feels sluggish and pacing is poor in higher waves. So, with this update, we will be spawning groups of infantries, versus a singular unit at times. Infantry will spawn significantly faster in higher waves, and as the game progresses, they will become faster. Units now will go around each other, versus clipping through one another, this also means that there is no longer a possibility for 2+ infantry being hidden within each other. Tanks, and armored vehicles (jeep, half-track...) will now spawn as a separate mini-wave of sorts. At the start of a wave infantry, and vehicles (if within the current wave), will spawn side-by-side. As vehicles require a few seconds between each other to spawn to prevent collisions it really slows down the game. If this isn't enough, we will further implement measures to combat these issues, such as an additional spawn point for vehicles. This will change how higher waves are played, as of before a single high-powered unit can take on a whole wave due to the spawning system flaws. With this being said, units like the flamethrower and grenadier will be very useful due to their crowd-control abilities. To even further the pace of later waves, we're adding a 3rd option for fast-forwarding to allow even faster gameplay.

- Enemies have significantly better pathfinding, they will stick to the middle of the path, versus cutting corners
- Enemy infantry move around each other, versus clipping through one another (vehicles still go through infantry due to path size limitations)
- Armored vehicles spawn independently of infantry significantly reducing wave time
- Enemy infantry spawn in groups now at higher waves, spawn rates are as follows:

Wave 1-11: 1 Unit   +0%  move speed.
Wave 12-17 2 Units  +5%  move speed.
Wave 18-23 3 Units  +10% move speed.
Wave 24+   4 Units  +15% move speed.
With more units planned at higher waves (still needs significant balancing for this, although a max spawn of 12 units is planned)

These values are all subject to change and may be different in the following updates.

Maps:
- Desert 1 has been visually reworked, to fit the style of the later maps
- Redid lighting for Forest 4, it is not as gloomy and has proper lighting. The map is still foggy as intended for a graveyard.
- Slight changes to the tutorial to mention new features

Gameplay:
- Added a 3x speed option, for faster gameplay
- Added the ability to continue a map in endless after victory
- Removed infantry projectiles for performance increase
- Selecting a unit will keep their stats on screen versus previously having to continuously hover over the unit

Balancing:
- Lowered American Juggernaut from 2000 to 1100 health (to match the German variant)
- Buffed US and German Assault towers base damage from 1.5 to 2
- Capped endless unit spawns to 10 separate enemy types, as too many units spawn per wave to progress to the next wave in a reasonable time

New UI Features:
- Integrated discord link within the main menu, feel free to join and give us some suggestions or report bugs/crashes
- Complete shop redesign, allowing to freely look at a unit

- Lowered M4A1 Sherman Upgrade 2's damage from 66 to 65
- Increased vertical targeting distance as certain units had issues firing when very high up

Additional Units:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43541946/67cd730d963fa7332ea54aae1d64ae01db7fd42e.png[/img]

Crash/Bug fixes:
- Fixed some potential issues that may cause crashes with units targeting
- Fixed game hanging/freezing whenever a tank made it through defenses to the end of the map
- Setup some measures to prevent crashes on Forest 5 (still need more data on crashes)
- Fixed enemy units moving after death whilst being burned by a flamethrower

Pending damage:

Units account for pending damage preventing multiple units from firing at a unit that's about to be dead, this means that units grouped up together will be doing significantly more damage, although overkilling an enemy can still happen, so we recommend a mixture of targeting set to Strongest and First.

Slow-attacking units, like tanks, will not fire at the enemy if it's already queued up enough damage to be considered dead in X seconds.
Preventing an issue where all your tanks fire at the first appearing enemy, when there are many more behind them that haven't gone into range just yet.

Units that attack fast will ignore pending damage on singular enemies as time to kill can have an impact in certain circumstances.

Maps:
- New collision preset for buildable objects
- Fixed collisions with certain static meshes on most maps, now allowing units to be placed on top of them such as on tops of bunkers
- Lowered the number of waves in Desert 2 to make it easier
- Added a new desert map

Range:
Per 1uu(unreal unit) above the path ~.286 range is added.
If relocating, the range will be updated immediately when issuing a movement command.
A tower placed level or below the path will keep its default range, no penalties are given.

UI:
The top left Unit Stats in-game has been reworked:
When you hover a unit, you will now see their stats (Country, DMG, RNG, APS, PEN, DMG Dealt)
When you click them, there will only be their name and level and the buttons to control them, which include Upgrading, Attack Priority, Movement, and Selling.
Fast Forward and Pause buttons have been moved to the top right in HUD.
Main menu text buttons have been made into icons.
Miscellaneous UI changes.

notes.title: Release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone we are proud to say we just released our first game into early access. It's been a long time coming and we've finally got something out there.

That being said here we are going to be watching our discord channel and our community forum for any bugs and feedback and start implementing those changes.

Currently, we are aware of some issues, there are some weird texture artifact lines happening on a few of the earlier maps in Campaign 1 and the tutorial. We are working on a solution for this and hopefully, it will be fixed soon. A few units have their movement disabled, currently the Pak 40 and the Machinegunner due to some issues with range while moving breaking we will get this fixed soon.

Next, we have some upcoming features coming within the next two weeks, a new map for the Desert Campaign and Winter Campaign. A new playable faction, the Allies, will include its own set of units, loadout, currency, and campaigns (based on the same maps). We are also going to move the "Play Endless" button into its own section within the play menu instead of being right next to it. 

We also will be implementing balancing changes, all towers and enemy units are subject to change once we start leaving what campaigns are too hard or too easy, and what units are too strong/weak. A lot of our focus will be on this throughout early access.

Thank you everyone and hope you enjoy the game.
